references.text: The tribe of Issachar is mentioned again in the camp arrangement, with the same number (54,400) as counted in the census.
The second census of the tribe of Issachar, showing the tribe's development over time in the wilderness.
The birth of Issachar, which is the origin of the tribe being counted here.
Issachar's sons who went down to Egypt, the ancestors of those now counted in the wilderness.
Jacob's blessing over Issachar, which prophesied about the tribe's character and future.
